$comment: Firefox's overrides (desktop and Android), merged over upstream's manifest_ff.json after patches/manifest.shiori.json (see there for the rules). Checked by scripts/build-extension.sh --target firefox; see docs/firefox-plan.md.
$comment_permissions: No 'cookies' (as on Safari) and no nativeMessaging: there's no app, settings live in storage.local (ext/host-local.js). menus: the right-click items (ext/menus.js).
$comment_bss: The add-on's ID is fixed: Mozilla's signing ties it to the account, and updates follow it. strict_min_version is the current ESR, for desktop and Android alike; it moves with the ESR. data_collection_permissions comes from upstream and stays honest: the extension sends the pages you visit and their content to your own server.
$comment_sidebar: Shiori in the sidebar: search your pages, and what you've saved from the site beside it (ext/sidebar.*). Desktop only; opened from View → Sidebar, or the command below (no key of its own: the user picks one).
$comment_omnibox: The address bar's keyword: 'sh lantern' suggests your pages from Hister (ext/omnibox.js).
$comment_incognito: Never in private windows: not loaded there at all.
$comment_options: Shiori's own settings page (ext/settings.html: there's no app to set them), opened in a tab, not inside about:addons.
$comment_commands: Control-Shift S, P and D are Firefox's own on Windows and Linux (screenshot, private window, bookmark all tabs), so Shiori's are Alt-Shift there; the Mac keeps Control-Shift, which Firefox leaves free. Firefox for Android has no keyboard shortcuts.

_execute_sidebar_action.description: Show or hide Shiori in the sidebar
